proof:
Source: step 6 of the parent proof ("M_r ⊆ M is null-measurable and countably n-rectifiable; θ > 0; ξ is a.e. strongly measurable for H⌞M_r ≤ H⌞M; orientation: by the sibling tangent_locality with (M′, θ′) := (M ∩ B_r, θ), V := B_r, (M Δ (M ∩ B_r)) ∩ B_r = ∅"), for an arbitrary open V and target domain U′. The local integrability on U′ depends on U′ and is therefore a hypothesis; the parent discharges it for U′ = ℝ^P, V = B_r(x₀) from the integrability of θ on M ∩ B̄_r(x₀) (B̄_r(x₀) ⊆ U compact), since M ∩ B_r(x₀) ∩ K ⊆ M ∩ B̄_r(x₀).

Notation. H := Hⁿ = μHE[n]; H⌞A := H.restrict A. We verify the seven fields of IsRectifiableTriple U′ n (M ∩ V) θ ξ, using the fields of the given triple (M, θ, ξ).

1. (subset) M ∩ V ⊆ U′ is a hypothesis.
2. (nullMeasurableSet) M is H-null-measurable (given field) and V is open, hence Borel. The intersection of an H-null-measurable set with a measurable set is H-null-measurable (NullMeasurableSet.inter), so M ∩ V is H-null-measurable.
3. (countablyRectifiable) M is countably n-rectifiable: M ⊆ M₀ ∪ ⋃_j F_j(ℝⁿ) with H(M₀) = 0 and each F_j Lipschitz. The same M₀ and F_j cover M ∩ V ⊆ M, so M ∩ V is countably n-rectifiable (CountablyRectifiable.mono).
4. (pos) If x ∈ M ∩ V then x ∈ M, so θ(x) > 0.
5. (integrableOn) For every compact K ⊆ U′, θ is H-integrable on (M ∩ V) ∩ K by hypothesis.
6. (aestronglyMeasurable) Since M ∩ V ⊆ M, H⌞(M ∩ V) ≤ H⌞M (Measure.restrict_mono). ξ is a.e. strongly measurable for H⌞M (given field), hence for the smaller measure H⌞(M ∩ V) (AEStronglyMeasurable.mono_measure).
7. (orients)
   (a) The orientation statement of (M, θ, ξ) holds for H⌞M-a.e. x; since M ∩ V ⊆ M it holds for H⌞(M ∩ V)-a.e. x (ae_restrict_of_ae_restrict_of_subset). By step 2, H⌞(M ∩ V)-a.e. x belongs to M ∩ V (ae_restrict_mem₀).
   (b) Fix x with both properties: x ∈ M ∩ V, and there is an orthonormal τ : Fin n → ℝ^P with HasWeightedApproximateTangentSpaceAt n M θ x (span(range τ)) and ξ(x) = simpleNVector τ or ξ(x) = −simpleNVector τ.
   (c) (M Δ (M ∩ V)) ∩ V = ∅: M Δ (M ∩ V) = (M ∖ (M ∩ V)) ∪ ((M ∩ V) ∖ M) = M ∖ V, which is disjoint from V. Hence H((M Δ (M ∩ V)) ∩ V) = H(∅) = 0.
   (d) Apply the sibling weighted_tangent_congr (br_weightedTangent_congr) with k := n and (M, M′, θ, θ′, x, V) := (M, M ∩ V, θ, θ, x, V): V is open; x ∈ V by (b); the null-set condition holds by (c); θ = θ holds everywhere, in particular H⌞(M ∩ V)-a.e.; and θ(x) = θ(x). With L := span(range τ) it yields HasWeightedApproximateTangentSpaceAt n (M ∩ V) θ x (span(range τ)).
   (e) Hence the same orthonormal τ witnesses the orientation statement of (M ∩ V, θ, ξ) at x: τ is orthonormal, span(range τ) is a weighted approximate tangent space of (M ∩ V, θ) at x by (d), and ξ(x) = ±simpleNVector τ by (b). By (a) this holds for H⌞(M ∩ V)-a.e. x.
8. (Conclusion.) All seven fields hold, so IsRectifiableTriple U′ n (M ∩ V) θ ξ. ∎

theorem Submission.br_loc_triple_inter_open : ∀ (P n : ℕ) (U U' V M : Set (Eucl P)) (θ : Eucl P → ℝ) (ξ : Eucl P → NVector (Eucl P) n), IsRectifiableTriple U n M θ ξ → IsOpen V → M ∩ V ⊆ U' → (∀ K : Set (Eucl P), IsCompact K → K ⊆ U' → IntegrableOn θ (M ∩ V ∩ K) (μHE[n] : Measure (Eucl P))) → IsRectifiableTriple U' n (M ∩ V) θ ξ := by
  intro P n U U' V M θ ξ hTr hV hsub hint
  have hnull : NullMeasurableSet (M ∩ V) (μHE[n] : Measure (Eucl P)) :=
    hTr.nullMeasurableSet.inter hV.measurableSet.nullMeasurableSet
  refine
    { subset := hsub
      nullMeasurableSet := hnull
      countablyRectifiable := hTr.countablyRectifiable.mono inter_subset_left
      pos := fun x hx => hTr.pos x hx.1
      integrableOn := hint
      aestronglyMeasurable :=
        hTr.aestronglyMeasurable.mono_measure (Measure.restrict_mono inter_subset_left le_rfl)
      orients := ?_ }
  have h1 : ∀ᵐ x ∂((μHE[n] : Measure (Eucl P)).restrict (M ∩ V)), ∃ τ : Fin n → Eucl P,
      Orthonormal ℝ τ ∧
      HasWeightedApproximateTangentSpaceAt n M θ x (Submodule.span ℝ (range τ)) ∧
      (ξ x = simpleNVector τ ∨ ξ x = -simpleNVector τ) :=
    ae_restrict_of_ae_restrict_of_subset inter_subset_left hTr.orients
  have hsd : (μHE[n] : Measure (Eucl P)) (symmDiff M (M ∩ V) ∩ V) = 0 := by
    have : symmDiff M (M ∩ V) ∩ V = ∅ := by
      ext x
      simp only [Set.mem_symmDiff, mem_inter_iff, mem_empty_iff_false, iff_false]
      tauto
    rw [this, measure_empty]
  filter_upwards [h1, ae_restrict_mem₀ hnull] with x hx hxMV
  obtain ⟨τ, hτ, htan, hξ⟩ := hx
  exact ⟨τ, hτ, Submission.br_weightedTangent_congr P n M (M ∩ V) θ θ x V hV hxMV.2 hsd
    (Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun _ => rfl)) rfl _ htan, hξ⟩
key_steps: subset, positivity and local integrability on U′ are immediate (the last is a hypothesis).
M ∩ V is Hⁿ-null-measurable (M null-measurable, V open) and countably n-rectifiable (subset of M).
ξ is a.e. strongly measurable for Hⁿ⌞(M ∩ V) ≤ Hⁿ⌞M.
For Hⁿ⌞(M ∩ V)-a.e. x: x ∈ M ∩ V and the orientation of (M, θ, ξ) gives an orthonormal τ with HasWeightedApproximateTangentSpaceAt n M θ x (span τ) and ξ(x) = ±τ₁ ∧ ⋯ ∧ τₙ.
Since (M Δ (M ∩ V)) ∩ V = ∅, x ∈ V and V is open, the sibling weighted_tangent_congr transfers the tangent space to (M ∩ V, θ), giving the orientation of the restricted triple.
